chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him)
In it he describes his time as characterized by injustice, and divides the people in it into five categories, then he induces aversion to the world as a consequence of the injustice of the time.

key_terms.جَوْر: Injustice, despotism, or deviation from truth

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali categorize people in his time according to the Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) identifies 'al-jawr' (injustice) as the defining characteristic of his era, a concept central to Shia political theology regarding the deviation of the Caliphate from divine justice. He categorizes the populace into five groups based on their spiritual and political alignment with this injustice, using this taxonomy to explain the collective disillusionment with worldly life. This passage underscores the Shia view that the corruption of leadership directly impacts the spiritual state of the community.

en.sayed-ali-raza: About the disparagement of the world
